note: Both sets invent airfoil names not present in the legends (Set A: FFA-W3-1 through -6, SNL-FFA, and a garbled 'SNL-FFA-WFA-W3-500'; Set B: FFA-W3-2, FFA-W3-3, SNL-FFA), and those claims are unsupported. Set B is stronger on the facts that are actually on the page: it captures the Reynolds numbers for all seven legend entries and binds several plausible cl, cd and cl/cd readings to real airfoils, whereas Set A gives only three Re claims and adds four dubious 'cl = 0.0 at AoA = 0' readings (the curves cross cl = 0 at negative angles) plus internally inconsistent peak values for the invented names. Set B does contain a few questionable chart readings (e.g. cl = 2.0 at AoA = 20 for SNL-FFA-W3-500) and contradictory duplicate maxima for the same invented airfoils, but overall it has more correct, well-bound claims and fewer outright fabrications.
